quests.question: This person uses old records and family trees to trace generations every day.
quests.hint: This person uses old records and family trees to trace generations every day.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a genealogist. Genealogists research family history and trace family trees. This job means using old records and family trees to trace generations every day.
quests.funFact: A genealogist can trace a family's story back hundreds of years!
quests.wordExample: The genealogist found an old photo of my great-grandparents.

quests.question: This person uses diving gear and a microscope to study ocean life every day.
quests.hint: This person uses diving gear and a microscope to study ocean life every day.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a marine biologist. Marine biologists study the plants and animals that live in the ocean. This job means using diving gear and a microscope to study ocean life every day.
quests.funFact: A marine biologist might study a single kind of fish for years!
quests.wordExample: The marine biologist studied a school of colorful fish.

quests.question: This person uses a hammer and leather to make and repair shoes every day.
